findings.title: Journal monitoring starts only after the pass exits
findings.description: `run()` uses blocking `subprocess.run()`, while `deploy/mt-run` waits until the service finishes. Consequently, `wait_for_unit_or_line()` cannot observe trailing completion and stop backfill while the pass runs. Start the service non-blockingly before polling. Add a test exercising the wrapper’s blocking behavior rather than mocking it away.

findings.title: Passwordless root execution trusts an operator-controlled script
findings.description: The rule authorizes root execution of an installer inside the operator’s checkout. The operator can replace that script and execute arbitrary commands as root; restricting arguments to `--ref` does not protect the script contents. Install the privileged entry point in a root-owned location with non-writable parent directories.

findings.title: Truncation index misses the spillover-only sessions being repaired
findings.description:
The newly reused `build_truncated_day_index()` inner-joins bars within `[session_open, session_close)` and only returns sessions whose newest bar equals the open. A session containing only the described 00:00 UTC spillover bar has no matching rows and is omitted. Meanwhile, the day-level coverage index considers that date covered, so no replacement gap is seeded.

Extend detection to covered dates with no in-session bars, and test the real SQL behavior with a spillover-only fixture rather than supplying a mocked truncation index.
